column2: [intro]
I put socks in the fridge, it's true,
And the keys on the paper roll too.
With me, it's a joyful mess,
I prefer to forget reality's stress.
In my life, everything's out of line,
I organize the world in my own design.
In the realm of colorful movie scenes,
The chaos of stars is where I feel serene.
The alarm rings, but I sleep in late,
My mind's eclectic, whimsical, and great.
In my room, it's a total jumble,
Disorder's my muse, my hidden rumble.
I only organize things in films,
Why keep it simple when you can thrill?
I escape into fantasy, it's my instinct's call,
The chaos of stars, my eccentric hall.
[ solo ]
In my life, everything's out of line,
I organize the world in my own design.
In the realm of colorful movie scenes,
The chaos of stars is where I feel serene.
[outro]
